# Kaka Bhaiya BBQ (Model Town D-Block Walay)

> Authentic charcoal-grilled Pakistani barbecue with 56+ years of heritage originating in 1970 at Model Town D-Block, now serving Lahore from 414-E Hoo Chowk, Johar Town. Famous for the legendary Bhaiya Special Beef Kabab, succulent Beef Boti, Chicken Malai Boti, and Crispy Paratha Rolls.

## Signature Dishes & Specialties
1. **Bhaiya Special Beef Kabab (1 Bite Seekh)**: Hand-minced prime Pakistani beef infused with 14 stone-ground spices, roasted cumin, and charred brown onions, slow-grilled over acacia charcoal embers. (1 Seekh: Rs. 450, 3 Seekh: Rs. 1,299, 6 Seekh: Rs. 2,499, 12 Seekh: Rs. 4,899).
2. **Beef Boti**: Melt-in-mouth beef tenderloin cubes cured in raw green papaya and mustard oil, charred to smoky perfection. (1 Seekh: Rs. 999, 3 Seekh: Rs. 2,899, 6 Seekh: Rs. 5,699, 12 Seekh: Rs. 10,999).
3. **Chicken Malai Boti**: Velvety boneless chicken breast steeped in fresh dairy cream, green cardamom, white pepper, and hung yogurt. (Rs. 720).
4. **Chicken Kasturi Boti**: Boneless chicken marinated with fragrant sun-dried kasuri methi, saffron-infused yogurt, and crushed coriander. (Rs. 720).
5. **Chicken Quarter Tikka (Leg / Breast Piece)**: Traditional bone-in chicken quarter bathed in Lahori red spices and seared on skewers over burning coal coals. (Leg: Rs. 450, Breast: Rs. 480).
6. **Bhaiya Beef Kabab Paratha Roll**: Two freshly charcoal-seared beef seekh kababs tucked inside a golden flaky paratha with mint-coriander raita and crunchy onions. (Rs. 340).
7. **Chicken BBQ Paratha Roll**: Charcoal-grilled chicken boti wrapped in crispy pan-layered paratha with spicy house chutney. (Rs. 340).
8. **Grill Fish (Seasonal Winter Special)**: Fresh river fish marinated in roasted carom (ajwain), sea salt, lemon, and stone-ground masalas, grilled over live coals (Half Kg: Rs. 1,580, 1 Kg: Rs. 2,990, 1.5 Kg: Rs. 4,390).
